sources.title: README.md
sources.finding: Early-stage Electron desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux. Independent sidecar PTYs, local files, editable Markdown/code tiles and local JSON state. No account required; PostHog anonymous usage analytics.

sources.title: LICENSE.md
sources.finding: Application uses Functional Source License 1.1 with Apache-2.0 future license. Competing commercial uses are restricted before the future-license conversion.

sources.title: Collaborator 0.8.4
sources.finding: Collaborator 0.8.4 was published 2026-06-16. Release notes describe the scoped changes; this is not a hands-on check.

sources.finding: collaborator.bot redirects to a 'Collab' page in closed beta with an early-access sign-up and no pricing.
